result.topic_en: Pencil sketches of circles and slit regions in the complex plane with points ±ai, together with the conformal map log((z+ai)/(z-ai)) and an integral of 1/((1-x)log(1-x)).

methods.what: Conformal map sending the points ai and -ai to infinity and zero (bipolar/logarithmic mapping of a doubly connected region)
Antiderivative of 1/((1-x)log(1-x)) as an iterated logarithm
